name: hcs-material-research-kit
description: Local-first virtual materials research studio: structures, reproducible classical simulations, provenance.
author: hcsmedia and timfromhcs

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hcs-materials/contracts && npm run build -w @hcs-materials/core && npm run build -w @hcs-materials/ui && npm run build -w @hcs-materials/visualization
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hcs-materials/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hcs-materials/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @hcs-materials/core && npm run typecheck -w @hcs-materials/ui && npm run typecheck -w @hcs-materials/visualization && npm run typecheck -w @hcs-materials/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @hcs-materials/web
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run preview -w @hcs-materials/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:rust && npm run build
